info.title: AnkiNX
info.author: Lucas H
info.details:
AnkiNX is a native homebrew port of Anki, an app that helps you memorise things with spaced repetition.

What it does

    -Reviews with Anki's scheduler: answer buttons, undo/redo, flag, bury, suspend, card info
    -Cards look as they do in Anki: HTML/CSS, images, audio, maths, template JavaScript, furigana, right-to-left text, type-in-the-answer and Image Occlusion
    -Deck overview, deck options, custom study, statistics and a read-only card browser
    -Buttons (rebindable; a single sideways Joy-Con works), touch, swipes and a whiteboard in handheld mode
    -English, Portuguese, Spanish and Japanese;


What it doesn't do
Adding and editing cards is not implemented. Typing and formatting cards with a controller and the on-screen keyboard would be cumbersome. Instead, create and edit your cards in Anki desktop, sync them through AnkiWeb, and review on the Switch. Your reviews sync back the same way.
